title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Maximizing Rewards on Business Travel and Tech Expenses
summary: Explains how to maximize rewards with the Business Silver Rewards Card by routing eligible travel/software spend for 10.0% earnings, using other purchases for 1.0%, and applying annual travel credits up to 50 toward eligible travel. Covers a 1.5% foreign transaction fee for international trips, issuing up to 17 employee cards, and verifying merchant category coding and requesting a charge review if misclassified.
faqs: Which transactions earn 10.0% on the Business Silver Rewards Card?
What earnings rate applies to non-travel/non-software purchases?
How do I use the annual travel credit (up to 50) for eligible travel?
What foreign transaction fee applies for international trips and how should I account for it?
How many employee cards can I issue and how should I assign them to capture rewards?
What should I do if a vendor’s charge seems misclassified for travel/software earning rates?
